title: E-QTM-0097: the quantum Hall staircase on the chiral walk: sweeping the coin angle continuously across a topological...
purpose: Experiment E-QTM-0097 in the quantum arena: the quantum Hall staircase on the chiral walk: sweeping the coin angle continuously across a topological transition, the measured invariant sits within 0.05 of the integer 0 on one side and 2 on the other at every sweep point (the plateau, an observable pinned at an integer against a continuous knob), steps only at the gap-closing angle where the critical point reads the midpoint 1.0, and the trivial-coin control shows no structure over the same sweep, which with the protection and edge-state results is the integer quantum Hall phenomenology on the model.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
